content:
*||Cato.  

From the moment I met you,
On that roof in London, watching the stars, 
Gazing at the celestial craters of a moon reflected in our dreams, 
Your love was there.  I knew that instant you were special. 
You looked up at the stars with me and I showed you my passions. 

I saw the awe and the wisdom in your beautiful eyes and you looked at me in a way nobody’d ever seen me before.

  When I saw we’d be sharing a room, every cell within me screamed for you.  
That night, after I’d announced the ball. 
I’d done it hoping you’d ask me, and you did. 
You asked if I could teach you how to dance. 
I took you down to the engine room, and we danced. 
We danced to memories of a better future.  

I asked you to marry me. 
And we planned. 
We were going to have a big barbecue and a ball outside and we were going to be married.  

We talked about adopting Skitter. 
And sponsoring Wren. 
And adopting all the children who were lost.   

Before the fight. 
Before that wretched, fated, horrible collection of moments,
You asked me to stay. 
I didn’t stay. 
I dragged us both into this. 
I thought I could be as wise and courageous as you were. I was wrong. I’m sorry. I failed you.  

Cato Zephyr, I love you with all my soul, and I pray one day our souls will return to each other’s embrace. You are my starlit sky, my sun-dappled forest, my love. ||*
